summary: Complete independent Chinese-source audit of all 228 source units, all 112 temporal and active-hint items, and all 45 people. Three repair groups are required: remove the Later Tang AD 923 retrospective date wrongly assigned to Liang Taizu; remove Cui Cong’s unsupported AD 931–932 interval from a source dated only by month; and correct the Han founder’s AD 206 era reversal to a properly sourced BC chronology. All other current conversions, event ownership, and qualitative antiquity labels were checked against their cited Chinese context.
